exposure: High-risk pregnancies (gestational hypertension, gestational diabetes mellitus, preterm labor, intrauterine growth restriction, multiple gestations)
Early detection and appropriate management of high-risk pregnancies
cohort: The study included 250 pregnant women with high-risk factors such as gestational hypertension, gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), preterm labor, intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR), and multiple gestations.
finding: Early detection and appropriate management of high-risk pregnancies improve maternal and neonatal outcomes.
cross-section timing: Data collected between January 2024 and June 2024.
